quizzes.title: Module 1 — Tuesday — Introduction to Design Software
quizzes.description: Tuesday's quiz covers the design software for both tracks: PixelLab and Lightroom Mobile for Smartphone Graphic Design, and Adobe Photoshop for PC Graphic Design — and why familiarity with your tools matters.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of becoming familiar with design software at this stage of the course?
options: To master every available design tool immediately
To become comfortable with the software's interface and working environment
To begin creating professional client projects
To learn how to use every feature before learning design principles
questions.explanation: This stage is about getting comfortable with the tools, not mastering them. Understanding the environment comes before producing finished work.

questions.prompt: Which software is the primary tool for the Smartphone Graphic Design track?
questions.explanation: PixelLab is the primary design application for the Smartphone track, supported by Lightroom Mobile for image work.

questions.prompt: What is Lightroom Mobile primarily introduced for in the Smartphone Graphic Design track?
questions.explanation: Lightroom Mobile is for working with and enhancing images, which becomes useful as the course progresses.

questions.prompt: When beginning with PixelLab, what should a learner focus on first?
options: Becoming familiar with the application's basic working environment
Creating a complete professional brand identity
questions.explanation: Start with the basic working environment. Knowing where the controls live is what makes the later design work easier.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of learning the Lightroom Mobile interface?
options: To understand where its major controls and features are located
questions.explanation: The goal is to know where its major controls and features are, so you can find what you need when you need it.

questions.prompt: Which software is used as the primary design application for the PC Graphic Design track?
questions.explanation: Adobe Photoshop is the primary design application for the PC Graphic Design track.

questions.prompt: When first learning Adobe Photoshop in this course, what should a beginner prioritise?
options: Understanding the workspace and becoming familiar with where major tools and controls are located
questions.explanation: Focus on the workspace first — where the major tools and panels are. Mastery of individual tools comes with use.

questions.prompt: Why is familiarity with design software important for a graphic designer?
options: It allows the designer to focus more easily on the actual design process rather than struggling with the working environment
It eliminates the need to understand design principles
It means the designer no longer needs to develop creative ideas
It guarantees that every design created will be effective
questions.explanation: When the tools are familiar, your attention goes to the design decisions instead of the software — which is where the real work is.
